injectRolloverFees(uint16,int256).notice: Applies a single manual adjustment to the rollover accumulators of a pair, on top of the continuous per block accrual. 'delta' is a per-OI amount in PRECISION_18 (same as accPerOi) 'delta' is added to the long side and subtracted from the short side. A positive 'delta' makes open longs pay an extra 'delta * notional' and credits open shorts the same per OI amount and vice versa.
